issues.issue: Was the applicant denied procedural fairness because his immigration consultant was negligent or incompetent?
issues.applicant_position: Consultant was negligent and incompetent: minimal preparation, unclear training of associate, no documents submitted.
issues.respondent_position: Conceded the notice criterion; the complaint about counsel's performance was disputed as conflicting and unclear.
issues.result_text: Court will not decide counsel's deficiency; the application fails on the prejudice criterion.

issues.issue: Would the alleged incompetence have changed the outcome, given the missing documents on Hamas forced recruitment and the narrative details?
issues.applicant_position: Reasonable probability that missing documents would have changed the outcome; documents support a forced recruitment claim.
issues.result_text: No reasonable probability the alleged incompetence changed the outcome; adverse credibility findings were supported.
